# Scenario cards

Each card gives a **goal and values as digits**. Say or write the request the way **you** would to
a voice assistant or a WhatsApp bot. Do not translate from the card. Use your own mix of Hindi and
English. If you would just type the digits, type the digits. Today's date is whatever date you write in
`written_on`; give relative days ("kal", "parson", "agle Monday") the way you naturally would.
All names, numbers and amounts here are made up.

| id | Domain | Goal |
|---|---|---|
| S01 | Delivery | Ask for parcel number PQ1021 to be delivered **the day after tomorrow**. Weight **1.5 kg**. |
| S02 | Delivery | Reschedule order number PQ1022 to **next Monday**, weight **2.5 kg**. |
| S03 | Delivery | Cancel order number PQ1023 that was meant for **tomorrow**. |
| S04 | Money transfer | Send **Rs 2,500** to a friend (phone number 98XXXXXX01). |
| S05 | Money transfer | Send **Rs 1,50,000** to your landlord for rent. |
| S06 | Money transfer | Send **Rs 375** to a shop. |
| S07 | Bill payment | Pay the electricity bill of **Rs 950**, due **this Wednesday**. |
| S08 | Bill payment | Pay the mobile bill of **Rs 399**, due **tomorrow**. |
| S09 | Loan | Ask for a loan of **Rs 5 lakh** for **36 months**. |
| S10 | Loan | Ask for a home loan of **Rs 1.5 crore** for **20 years**. |
| S11 | Recharge | Recharge phone 98XXXXXX02 with **Rs 666**. |
